video_title: Full Denver Nuggets Postgame Media Availability vs. UTA 🎙

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on Nuggets' improved offensive system and young player performance
quotes.excerpt: I was really proud of the young guys too in the second half. They were better.
quotes.quote: It was better. It wasn't perfect by any means, but much better. I thought full offensive half. Had some breakdowns one-on-one defensively, but much better system-wise as far as X-outs and things that we talked about doing. So yeah, there was enough improvement. I was really proud of the young guys too in the second half. They were better. I thought they were much more competitive than they were in Game 1. So, preseason, you look at it, you watch the film, lots of film to watch, long way to go.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman says the Nuggets showed improvement in their offensive system and competitiveness against Utah. It was not perfect, but he was proud of the young guys in the second half.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman praises Marvin Bagley III's debut performance and defensive effort
quotes.excerpt: His gift of picking up the ball and defending is obvious. So really proud of him.
quotes.quote: He was awesome. He was great tonight. You have to survive in this league or in those leagues, in EuroLeague, these are big-time basketball leagues. You have to know who you are. Obviously he does. He still has to get used to our offensive system and all those things, but his gift of picking up the ball and defending is obvious. So really proud of him. His effort was great.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman on Marvin Bagley III after his debut: He was awesome. His gift of picking up the ball and defending is obvious.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on Jamal Murray's impact on offensive flow and execution
quotes.excerpt: It was just good to see them making the right play for each other.
quotes.quote: Last game without Jamal and this game with him, I thought the looks were great. We had great shots. They took care of the ball. I thought we could have scored in the 70s in the first half. So our offense, it's going to be what it is. It's been very good for a long time. It was historically good last year. So it was just good to see them making the right play for each other, making the right pass every time, which is what we preach. When you have really good players and they do that, you're going to score a lot of points.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman says the Nuggets offense is going to be what it is, noting it was historically good last year. He was pleased to see the team making the right pass every time.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman highlights Alpha's defensive contributions and competitive spirit
quotes.excerpt: Alpha stood out. He guarded their best players. He did things other guys weren't doing tonight.
quotes.quote: I'd say Alpha. Alpha stood out. He guarded their best players. He got into them. He did things other guys weren't doing tonight, and he has that natural ability. So like I said, it's going to be a competition with these guys to try to find minutes. It's not easy. Spencer Jones isn't even playing. So the minutes to be found will be earned, but he had a really good night.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman highlights Alpha for his defensive effort against Utah, noting he did things other guys were not doing. He adds that the minutes to be found in the rotation will be earned.

quotes.speaker: Marvin Bagley III
quotes.summary_phrase: Marvin Bagley III on his aggressive approach and team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: First of all, I just want to thank Jesus. Without him, I wouldn't be here.
quotes.quote: First of all, I just want to thank Jesus. Without him, I wouldn't be here. Tonight, just try to come out and be aggressive, try to get in my spots, create pockets for my teammates to either dish the ball or for them to come off aggressive. Just communicating a little more on the defensive end as well, and just continuing to work on our stuff, man. I think Game 2, we took a step today, got better than last game, and we just got to keep putting one foot in front of the other and just continue to grow as a team together.
quotes.social_post: Marvin Bagley III says he is focused on being aggressive and creating pockets for his teammates. He believes the team took a step forward in Game 2.

quotes.speaker: Marvin Bagley III
quotes.summary_phrase: Marvin Bagley III on learning the Nuggets' system from AG
quotes.excerpt: I've been talking to AG a lot about just the system, how things are done here.
quotes.quote: I've been talking to AG a lot about just the system, how things are done here. They've been doing it at a high level for a while now. So for me to come in and soak up all the knowledge and try to get out there and just help them continue to build that, you know, that's what it's about, man. And he's been a big help. So is the other guys, the coaching staff. I'm excited about what we can continue to build.
quotes.social_post: Marvin Bagley III says he has been leaning on Aaron Gordon to learn the Nuggets system. He is excited about what they can continue to build together.

quotes.speaker: Marvin Bagley III
quotes.summary_phrase: Marvin Bagley III on developing his playmaking from the top of the key
quotes.excerpt: I work on that in the summertime, making plays out of the top of the key.
quotes.quote: I love it. I work on that in the summertime, making plays out of the top of the key, elbows, either block. Yeah, so to be able to come here and do it, it's like second nature. So I'm just like I said, just trying to figure out the system, figure out how to get in there and make a positive impact and just continue to grow every game.
quotes.social_post: Marvin Bagley III says making plays from the top of the key is second nature to him. He is focused on figuring out the system to make a positive impact.

quotes.speaker: Aaron Gordon
quotes.summary_phrase: Aaron Gordon on defensive focus and individual responsibility
quotes.excerpt: I think we're still lacking on defensive bit. Stuff slow, not quite in the right positions.
quotes.quote: I feel good. I think we're still lacking on defensive bit. Stuff slow, not quite in the right positions, and then at the same when it comes down to it, we got to be able to guard one-on-one. So not good enough defensively.
quotes.social_post: Aaron Gordon is not satisfied with the Nuggets defense, saying they are not quite in the right positions and need to be able to guard one-on-one. He admits it is not good enough.

quotes.speaker: Aaron Gordon
quotes.summary_phrase: Aaron Gordon on preseason chemistry and defensive improvement
quotes.excerpt: Our offense is second to none, I believe. Defensively, we got to pick it up.
quotes.quote: This is what preseason is for, ironing out some things, knocking off the rust. I look forward to us getting together on the defensive end. Our offense is second to none, I believe. I think statistically we're second to none. So defensively, we got to pick it up.
quotes.social_post: Aaron Gordon says the Nuggets offense is second to none, but the team needs to pick it up on the defensive end during the preseason.

quotes.speaker: Aaron Gordon
quotes.summary_phrase: Aaron Gordon on Marvin Bagley III's performance and team fit
quotes.excerpt: Marvin's killing. He's been killing all camp, he's been killing all summer.
quotes.quote: Marvin's killing. He's been killing all camp, he's been killing all summer, and we expect him to have, you know, just continue to be himself and play his game. He has a wonderful opportunity here, and he's going to help us very much lift that second unit and be big when Joker's off the floor.
quotes.social_post: Aaron Gordon says Marvin Bagley III has been killing it all camp and expects him to be big for the second unit when Joker is off the floor.

quotes.speaker: Julian Strawther
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Strawther on adjusting to the team and getting acclimated
quotes.excerpt: Right now, it's just focused on getting acclimated, playing with the guys.
quotes.quote: I felt pretty good, but right now, it's just focused on getting acclimated, playing with the guys, and you know, everybody getting their feet wet. So it's good to get a win and get back home.
quotes.social_post: Julian Strawther says he is focused on getting acclimated and playing with the guys as the team gets their feet wet in the preseason.

quotes.speaker: Julian Strawther
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Strawther on the challenge of learning a new system
quotes.excerpt: Just how new it is, all the guys, the system, the plays, everything.
quotes.quote: Just how new it is, all the guys, the system, the plays, everything. You know, just the little tweaks and changes, getting used to everything. But as time goes, we get more comfortable and ready to get back home.
quotes.social_post: Julian Strawther on the adjustment period: It is all about learning the new system, the plays, and the little tweaks and changes.

quotes.speaker: Julian Strawther
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Strawther on team chemistry and locker room dynamics
quotes.excerpt: We got a lot of like-minded guys in the locker room. It's easy to play with each other.
quotes.quote: We got a lot of like-minded guys in the locker room. It's easy for us to play with each other, play one another, find each other in their spots. I feel like everybody played the right way.
quotes.social_post: Julian Strawther says the Nuggets have a lot of like-minded guys in the locker room, making it easy to play with one another and find each other in their spots.

quotes.speaker: Julian Strawther
quotes.summary_phrase: Julian Strawther on the importance of road trips for team bonding
quotes.excerpt: That week in Boulder was big time for us, being around each other.
quotes.quote: That week in Boulder was big time for us, being around each other, getting back to seeing each other on a daily basis, feeling each other's energy. So it's been fun. I'm excited to see where this group can go. And how fun was it to see Ralfy run? My dog, Yoke, was super happy with that one. He was super excited. So that was fun.
quotes.social_post: Julian Strawther says the team's time in Boulder was big for bonding and feeling each other's energy.
